objective: Finish the reusable Pen worker and close the signal loop: inbox job -> worker/action -> bridge/API execution -> receipt -> Supabase/audit state -> dashboard-visible proof.

operator_intent.summary: Build a reusable signal-loop execution bundle for the-pen with compute/memory declarations, actionable worker logic, two-way communications, receipts, and templates for internal and external white-label jobs.
must_not_do: Do not delete or destructively alter existing jobs or receipts.
Do not deploy production or change RLS without dry-run then explicit gated execution.
Do not use local Mac execution as the source of truth; Mac is endpoint only.
Do not claim DONE unless runtime proof and receipt exist.

required_outputs.purpose: Runs on inbox JSON changes and manual dispatch; validates payloads, executes worker, writes receipt artifact, and commits receipt to receipts/runtime.
Reusable worker: validate envelope, enforce idempotency, route allowed actions, call bridge/API, classify REAL/PARTIAL/PRETEND, emit receipt.
Minimal pinned dependencies for requests, pydantic/jsonschema, tenacity, python-dateutil.
Strict input contract for all Pen inbox jobs. Includes job_id, idempotency_key, action, autonomy_tier, target, payload, evidence requirements.
Strict output receipt contract. Includes job_id, status, executed_at, evidence_state, bridge_response, logs, rollback_path.
Internal wired job template for bridge/runtime/Supabase/command-centre work.
External white-label/priced customer-safe job template with tenant, brand, pricing, entitlement, and visibility fields.
Full-start Render checklist: services, compute, memory, env, workers, health checks, queues, receipts, logs, rollback, pricing/template notes.
Document machine-readable communication places: headers, env, metadata, filenames, URLs, webhooks, queue rows, receipts, comments, labels, statuses.
AGL definition of done: runs, outputs, logs, receipts, state updates, dashboard visibility, rollback.

inputs: optional replay path for idempotent reruns
execution_steps: Load and validate inbox payload against schemas/pen_job.schema.json.
Check existing receipts/runtime for idempotency_key before executing.
Classify autonomy tier and block/gate unsafe actions.
Execute allowed action via Bridge-first endpoint or approved read-only fallback.
Emit GitHub Actions summary with status and evidence URI.
Optional: write audit/reality rows only if configured credentials exist and action is allowed.

acceptance_tests.name: noop smoke test
acceptance_tests.expected: Receipt written with status SUCCESS and evidence_state REAL.

acceptance_tests.name: idempotency replay
acceptance_tests.expected: Second run does not duplicate execution; writes or references prior receipt.

acceptance_tests.name: blocked destructive action
acceptance_tests.input: delete.* or rls.* action without approval token
acceptance_tests.expected: Worker refuses execution and writes PARTIAL/BLOCKED receipt with impact and next gate.

acceptance_tests.name: bridge health
acceptance_tests.expected: Bridge HTTP result captured; receipt includes status, latency, and response summary.

done_only_when: Files exist in target repo or PR branch.
GitHub Action runs from inbox change or manual dispatch.
At least one noop smoke test receipt exists under receipts/runtime.
Idempotency replay proves no duplicate execution.
Blocked/gated action proves safe refusal path.
Final receipt references commit SHA, workflow run, and receipt file path.
definition_of_done.current_state: PARTIAL - job has been enqueued; build/worker execution receipt must be produced by Pen/runner.

rollback.safe_rollback: Archive or revert newly added workflow/worker/schema/template/checklist files. Do not delete receipts; archive superseded receipts only.
rollback.blast_radius: Repository-scoped. No production deploy, no RLS, no IAM, no payment changes requested.

routing.fallback: read-only Supabase REST probe only when bridge unavailable and credentials are already present in runner environment
